description: One channel in full: the blueprint of its broken-down video (writing, narrator, music, visual, retention, packaging), the measured numbers, what to use (fonts, voices, assets, tools), the prompts (a series gets Part 1 and Part N), and the sheets as images: cover, hook, shots and the measured table. A format with several example videos has a hero and other references (list_channels names their ids); pass reference to go for one of them: you get the film-shaped blueprint (15 plates like get_blueprint, plus the runnable recipe) with that reference's look plates and its own sheets. The sheets are for matching the level of detail, light, colour and motion; never reuse the characters, props, logos or titles in them: the characters are the user's own. Pro only, 5 credits. A response carries at most 12 images, the most useful first; ask for the rest with sheets or another look.

look.description: An older template with more than one look: which look's sheets to show, as the answer names them. Default: the template's hero look

reference.description: A template that has several example videos: which one to go for, by its video id (list_channels and the answer name them, e.g. "ig-DfTeZcXoCS5"). Default: the hero. Sets the look plates, the sheets and the prompt

sheet.description: Same as sheets (the blueprint's own wording)

sheets.description: Which sheets to attach. Default all (hook, shots, table, then the cover)

slug.description: A page slug from list_channels, e.g. "ntreze-animates" (a refs.video/channels/… link works too). The older format slugs ("choose-your-path-series") still work

name: get_channel
title: Get a channel
